notes.title: Magical Girl D demo is now on Steam!
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that Magical Girl D is finally playable on Steam!

That's right... You can now download the v0.2.0 demo, which features 2 playable characters, loads of sex scenes and most importantly, some hot futa and yuri action!

Hit that download button and give the game a spin. Be sure to tell us what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1666640/Magical_Girl_D__Futanari_RPG

Remember, you can join our Discord channel to keep up to date with the game's progress!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/43NK5jw27U]https://discord.com/invite/43NK5jw27U[/url]
